PTM Statistics: DPA, DPU, and CorrectFirst

  • Overview
  • DPA
  • DPU
  • CorrectFirst DPU
  • Session Info

This report compares three complementary views of PTM regulation from one completed MuData analysis. DPA describes the observed change at each PTM site. DPU subtracts the protein-level change after modelling. CorrectFirst DPU first corrects site abundances by their protein abundances and then fits the model.

The detailed input references and software versions are recorded in Session Info.

  • Summary
  • Volcano
  • Site vs protein
  • Sequence logos
  • Difference logos
  • Results

Differential PTM abundance reports the site-level effect before protein correction. It is the direct answer to “did this measured PTM site change?”

  • Plot
  • Table

The logos use significant, sequence-validated PTM sites and separate each contrast and regulation direction. Panel labels report the number of sites; letter height is the amino-acid probability at that position. On-render selection: FDR < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 0.5.

These logos are recomputed from MuData during rendering using FDR < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 0.5.

  • Summary
  • Volcano
  • Site vs protein
  • Sequence logos
  • Difference logos
  • Results

Differential PTM usage compares the modelled site change with the modelled protein change. A positive value means the site increased more than its protein; a negative value means it increased less or decreased more. Only a site whose protein has a result has a usage change, so DPU holds the matched sites.

  • Plot
  • Table

The DPU logos group sites by the direction of their protein-adjusted change. Panel labels report the number of sites entering each motif. On-render selection: FDR < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 0.5.

These logos are recomputed from MuData during rendering using FDR < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 0.5.

  • Summary
  • Quality control
  • Volcano
  • Sequence logos
  • Difference logos
  • Results

CorrectFirst subtracts the protein abundance from the site abundance on the log2 scale and adds back the sample’s median protein abundance before modelling. A protein value missing in a sample is taken from the protein DEA’s lm_impute model, so every site whose protein was quantified is corrected. The fitted site effect is then the change in PTM usage.

The two plots assess the protein-corrected sample-level values entering the CorrectFirst model.

  • Plot
  • Table

The CorrectFirst logos use the direction of the effect fitted after sample-level protein correction. Panel labels report the number of sites entering each motif. On-render selection: FDR < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 0.5.

These logos are recomputed from MuData during rendering using FDR < 0.05 and |log2 fold change| > 0.5.

```{r setup}
#| include: false
required_packages <- c(
  "DT",
  "dplyr",
  "fgczQuartoTemplate",
  "ggplot2",
  "ggseqlogo",
  "knitr",
  "prolfqua",
  "prophosqua"
)
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE, FUN.VALUE = logical(1))
]
if (length(missing_packages)) {
  stop(
    "Missing package(s) required to render this report: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

input_h5mu <- params$input_h5mu
if (is.null(input_h5mu) || !length(input_h5mu) || !nzchar(input_h5mu)) {
  input_h5mu <- system.file(
    "extdata",
    "ptm_results_example",
    "PTM_results.h5mu",
    package = "prophosqua"
  )
}
if (!nzchar(input_h5mu) || !file.exists(input_h5mu)) {
  stop("PTM statistics MuData file not found: ", input_h5mu, call. = FALSE)
}
input_h5mu <- normalizePath(input_h5mu, mustWork = TRUE)
fdr_threshold <- as.numeric(params$fdr_threshold)
fold_change_threshold <- as.numeric(params$fold_change_threshold)
if (length(fdr_threshold) != 1L || !is.finite(fdr_threshold) ||
    fdr_threshold <= 0 || fdr_threshold > 1) {
  stop("fdr_threshold must be one number in (0, 1].", call. = FALSE)
}
if (length(fold_change_threshold) != 1L ||
    !is.finite(fold_change_threshold) || fold_change_threshold < 0) {
  stop("fold_change_threshold must be one non-negative number.", call. = FALSE)
}
logo_selection <- paste0(
  "FDR < ",
  format(fdr_threshold),
  " and |log2 fold change| > ",
  format(fold_change_threshold)
)

# Production renders use PTM_statistics.h5mu. The bundled vignette example is
# a complete PTM_results.h5mu, which contains the same typed statistics stage.
ptm_stage <- prophosqua::read_ptm_h5mu(input_h5mu)
statistics <- if (inherits(ptm_stage, "PTM_statistics")) {
  ptm_stage
} else if (inherits(ptm_stage, "PTM_results")) {
  ptm_stage$get_statistics()
} else {
  stop("Expected PTM_statistics or PTM_results MuData.", call. = FALSE)
}
inputs <- statistics$get_inputs()
dpa_dpu <- statistics$get_dpa_dpu()
cf <- statistics$get_cf()
# Every analysis is computed from all models; the report shows only the rows
# whose site estimate is observed, and counts the imputed ones.
dpa <- prophosqua::observed_site_estimates(as.data.frame(dpa_dpu$combined_site_prot))
dpu <- prophosqua::observed_site_estimates(as.data.frame(dpa_dpu$combined_test_diff))
# The reported CorrectFirst is corrected with the protein DEA's imputed values.
cf_reported <- statistics$get_cf_reported()
cf_results <- prophosqua::observed_site_estimates(as.data.frame(cf_reported$results), "estimate_type")
estimate_counts <- statistics$get_estimate_counts()
design <- inputs$get_design()
contrasts <- inputs$get_contrasts()
provenance <- inputs$get_provenance()

empty_plot <- function(label) {
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = label) +
    ggplot2::theme_void()
}

safe_plot <- function(expr, label) {
  tryCatch(expr, error = function(error) {
    empty_plot(paste(label, conditionMessage(error), sep = "\n"))
  })
}

volcano_plot <- function(data, effect, fdr, title) {
  if (!all(c(effect, fdr, "contrast") %in% names(data))) {
    return(empty_plot("The required volcano-plot columns are unavailable."))
  }
  plot_data <- data[
    is.finite(data[[effect]]) & is.finite(data[[fdr]]),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (!nrow(plot_data)) {
    return(empty_plot("No finite estimates are available."))
  }
  plot_data$significant <-
    plot_data[[fdr]] <= fdr_threshold &
      abs(plot_data[[effect]]) >= fold_change_threshold
  plot_data$negative_log10_fdr <- -log10(pmax(plot_data[[fdr]], .Machine$double.xmin))
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data[[effect]],
      y = .data$negative_log10_fdr,
      colour = .data$significant
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(-fold_change_threshold, fold_change_threshold),
      colour = "grey55",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(
      yintercept = -log10(fdr_threshold),
      colour = "grey55",
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(ggplot2::vars(.data$contrast), scales = "free") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(`FALSE` = "grey70", `TRUE` = "#cf3c4f"),
      labels = c(`FALSE` = "No", `TRUE` = "Yes")
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = title,
      x = "log2 fold change",
      y = "-log10(FDR)",
      colour = "Passes thresholds"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

site_protein_plot <- function(data) {
  required <- c("diff.protein", "diff.site", "contrast")
  if (!all(required %in% names(data))) {
    return(empty_plot("Site and protein fold changes are unavailable."))
  }
  plot_data <- data[
    is.finite(data$diff.protein) & is.finite(data$diff.site),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  if (!nrow(plot_data)) {
    return(empty_plot("No paired site and protein estimates are available."))
  }
  plot_data$usage_change <- plot_data$diff.site - plot_data$diff.protein
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$diff.protein,
      y = .data$diff.site,
      colour = .data$usage_change
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.55, size = 1.2) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(ggplot2::vars(.data$contrast), scales = "free") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_gradient2(
      low = "#2c7bb6",
      mid = "grey85",
      high = "#d7191c",
      midpoint = 0
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Protein log2 fold change",
      y = "PTM-site log2 fold change",
      colour = "DPU"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")
}

dt_table <- function(data, caption, columns, page_length = 15) {
  columns <- intersect(columns, names(data))
  table <- if (length(columns)) data[, columns, drop = FALSE] else data
  if (!nrow(table)) {
    table <- data.frame(message = "No result rows are available.")
  }
  DT::datatable(
    table,
    caption = caption,
    filter = "bottom",
    rownames = FALSE,
    class = "compact stripe",
    options = list(
      pageLength = page_length,
      scrollX = TRUE,
      scrollY = "420px",
      deferRender = TRUE
    )
  )
}

estimate_count_table <- function(analysis) {
  knitr::kable(dplyr::select(estimate_counts[estimate_counts$analysis == analysis, ], -"analysis"))
}

modification_counts <- function(data) {
  if (!all(c("contrast", "modAA") %in% names(data))) {
    return(data.frame(message = "Modification annotations are unavailable."))
  }
  dplyr::count(data, .data$contrast, .data$modAA, name = "sites") |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$contrast, dplyr::desc(.data$sites))
}

prepare_logo_sites <- function(data, effect, fdr) {
  required <- c("contrast", "SequenceWindow", "modAA", effect, fdr)
  if (!all(required %in% names(data))) {
    return(data.frame())
  }
  sites <- prophosqua::filter_significant_sites(
    data,
    fdr_col = fdr,
    diff_col = effect,
    fdr_threshold = fdr_threshold,
    fc_threshold = fold_change_threshold,
    require_sequence = TRUE
  )
  sites
}

format_contrast <- function(contrast) {
  gsub("_", " ", contrast, fixed = TRUE)
}

logo_counts <- function(data) {
  if (!nrow(data)) {
    return(data.frame(Message = "No sites pass the displayed thresholds."))
  }
  data |>
    dplyr::count(
      .data$contrast,
      .data$regulation,
      .data$modAA,
      name = "Sites"
    ) |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Contrast = format_contrast(.data$contrast),
      Direction = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$regulation == "upregulated",
        "Up",
        "Down"
      ),
      `Modified residue` = .data$modAA,
      .data$Sites
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Contrast, .data$Direction, .data$`Modified residue`)
}

logo_theme <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
    strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.8, "lines"),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(4, 8, 4, 8)
  )
}

sequence_logo_plot <- function(data) {
  if (!nrow(data)) {
    return(empty_plot("No sites pass the displayed thresholds."))
  }
  sequence_groups <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = dplyr::if_else(
        .data$regulation == "upregulated",
        "Up",
        "Down"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$contrast, .data$direction) |>
    dplyr::summarize(
      sequences = list(.data$SequenceWindow),
      sites = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      group = paste0(
        format_contrast(.data$contrast),
        " · ",
        .data$direction,
        " (n=",
        .data$sites,
        ")"
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$group) |>
    dplyr::summarize(
      sequences = .data$sequences,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  sequence_groups <- stats::setNames(
    sequence_groups$sequences,
    sequence_groups$group
  )
  ggseqlogo::ggseqlogo(
    sequence_groups,
    ncol = 2,
    seq_type = "aa",
    method = "probability"
  ) +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(15L),
      labels = -7:7,
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = "Position relative to modified residue",
      y = "Amino-acid probability",
      fill = "Amino-acid chemistry"
    ) +
    logo_theme()
}

difference_logo_plot <- function(data) {
  if (!nrow(data)) {
    return(empty_plot("No sites pass the displayed thresholds."))
  }
  plot <- prophosqua::plot_diff_logo(data)
  if (is.null(plot)) {
    return(empty_plot("Both directions are required for a difference logo."))
  }
  contrasts <- unique(data$contrast)
  labels <- vapply(contrasts, function(contrast) {
    contrast_data <- data[data$contrast == contrast, , drop = FALSE]
    paste0(
      format_contrast(contrast),
      " · Up n=",
      sum(contrast_data$regulation == "upregulated"),
      " − Down n=",
      sum(contrast_data$regulation == "downregulated")
    )
  }, character(1))
  names(labels) <- paste0(contrasts, " (Up-Down)")
  layer_data <- plot$layers[[1L]]$data
  layer_data$seq_group <- unname(labels[layer_data$seq_group])
  plot$layers[[1L]]$data <- layer_data
  plot +
    ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq_len(15L),
      labels = -7:7,
      expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = NULL,
      x = "Position relative to modified residue",
      y = "Δ probability (up − down)",
      fill = "Amino-acid chemistry"
    ) +
    logo_theme()
}

dpa_logo_sites <- prepare_logo_sites(dpa, "diff.site", "FDR.site")
dpu_logo_sites <- prepare_logo_sites(dpu, "diff_diff", "FDR_I")
cf_logo_sites <- prepare_logo_sites(cf_results, "diff.site", "FDR.site")

source_paths <- provenance$paths
if (is.null(source_paths)) {
  source_paths <- character()
}
```

# Overview

<img src="`r knitr::image_uri(system.file("report-assets", "ptm-statistics.svg", package = "prophosqua"))`" alt="Visual abstract showing enriched PTM and total-proteome measurements entering DPA, DPU, and CorrectFirst DPU branches, followed by comparable plots and result tables." style="width: 100%; max-height: 22rem; object-fit: contain;">

This report compares three complementary views of PTM regulation from one completed MuData analysis. **DPA** describes the observed change at each PTM site. **DPU** subtracts the protein-level change after modelling. **CorrectFirst DPU** first corrects site abundances by their protein abundances and then fits the model.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-overview-input-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Input summary for the completed PTM statistics analysis."
overview <- data.frame(
  Measure = c("Samples", "PTM sites", "Proteins", "Contrasts"),
  Count = c(
    nrow(design),
    dplyr::n_distinct(dpa_dpu$combined_site_prot$site),
    dplyr::n_distinct(dpa_dpu$combined_site_prot$protein_Id),
    length(contrasts)
  )
)
knitr::kable(overview)
```

::: {layout-ncol="2"}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-overview-contrasts
#| tbl-cap: "Contrasts evaluated by DPA, DPU and CorrectFirst DPU."
knitr::kable(data.frame(Contrast = names(cf$contrasts), Definition = unname(cf$contrasts)))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-overview-match-rate
#| tbl-cap: "PTM sites paired with a protein-level estimate in each contrast; only these enter DPU and CorrectFirst DPU."
knitr::kable(dpa_dpu$match_rates, digits = 1)
```

:::

The detailed input references and software versions are recorded in **Session Info**.

# DPA

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Summary

Differential PTM abundance reports the site-level effect before protein correction. It is the direct answer to “did this measured PTM site change?”

::: {layout-ncol="2"}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dpa-estimate-counts
#| tbl-cap: "DPA site-contrast rows by site estimate type. All are computed; this report shows only the observed ones."
estimate_count_table("DPA")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dpa-modification-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Observed DPA rows by contrast and modified amino acid."
knitr::kable(modification_counts(dpa))
```

:::

## Volcano

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpa-volcano
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Differential PTM abundance by contrast. Each point is one PTM site; the
#|   x-axis is its site-level log2 fold change and the y-axis is -log10(FDR).
#|   Red points pass the displayed absolute fold-change and FDR thresholds.
volcano_plot(dpa, "diff.site", "FDR.site", "Differential PTM abundance")
```

## Site vs protein

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpa-site-protein
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   PTM-site log2 fold change as a function of the matched protein log2 fold
#|   change. Each point is one matched site; the diagonal denotes equal site and
#|   protein change, and colour is their difference, the DPU effect.
site_protein_plot(dpa)
```

## Sequence logos

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Plot

The logos use significant, sequence-validated PTM sites and separate each contrast and regulation direction. Panel labels report the number of sites; letter height is the amino-acid probability at that position. **On-render selection:** `r logo_selection`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpa-sequence-logos
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Sequence motifs around differentially abundant PTM sites. Each panel
#|   contains one contrast and regulation direction after applying the displayed
#|   FDR and absolute fold-change thresholds.
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.2
#| out-width: "60%"
sequence_logo_plot(dpa_logo_sites)
```

### Table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dpa-logo-counts
#| tbl-cap: "DPA sites entering the sequence logos by contrast, direction, and modified residue."
knitr::kable(logo_counts(dpa_logo_sites), align = c("l", "l", "c", "r"))
```

:::

## Difference logos

These logos are recomputed from MuData during rendering using **`r logo_selection`**.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpa-difference-logos
#| fig-cap: >-

#|   upregulated sites; letters below zero are enriched around downregulated
#|   sites in the same contrast.
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| out-width: "60%"
difference_logo_plot(dpa_logo_sites)
```

## Results

```{r}

dt_table(

  "Differential PTM abundance results",
  c(
    "protein_Id", "site", "gene_name.site", "modAA", "posInProtein",
    "SequenceWindow", "contrast", "diff.site", "FDR.site",
    "diff.protein", "FDR.protein", "estimate_type.site"
  )
)
```

:::

# DPU

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Summary

Differential PTM usage compares the modelled site change with the modelled protein change. A positive value means the site increased more than its protein; a negative value means it increased less or decreased more. Only a site whose protein has a result has a usage change, so DPU holds the matched sites.

::: {layout-ncol="2"}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dpu-estimate-counts
#| tbl-cap: "DPU site-contrast rows by site estimate type. All are computed; this report shows only the observed ones; their protein estimate may be imputed."
estimate_count_table("DPU")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dpu-modification-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Observed DPU rows by contrast and modified amino acid."
knitr::kable(modification_counts(dpu))
```

:::

## Volcano

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpu-volcano
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Differential PTM usage by contrast. Each point is one PTM site; the x-axis
#|   is the site-minus-protein log2 fold change and the y-axis is -log10(FDR)
#|   after propagated site and protein uncertainty. Red points pass both
#|   displayed thresholds.
volcano_plot(dpu, "diff_diff", "FDR_I", "Differential PTM usage")
```

## Site vs protein

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpu-site-protein
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Site and protein log2 fold changes used to calculate DPU. Points above the
#|   diagonal have positive PTM usage changes and points below it have negative
#|   usage changes; colour shows the signed site-minus-protein difference.
site_protein_plot(dpu)
```

## Sequence logos

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Plot

The DPU logos group sites by the direction of their protein-adjusted change. Panel labels report the number of sites entering each motif. **On-render selection:** `r logo_selection`.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpu-sequence-logos
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Sequence motifs around sites with significant differential PTM usage,
#|   separated by contrast and direction.
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5.2
#| out-width: "60%"
sequence_logo_plot(dpu_logo_sites)
```

### Table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dpu-logo-counts
#| tbl-cap: "DPU sites entering the sequence logos by contrast, direction, and modified residue."
knitr::kable(logo_counts(dpu_logo_sites), align = c("l", "l", "c", "r"))
```

:::

## Difference logos

These logos are recomputed from MuData during rendering using **`r logo_selection`**.

```{r}
#| label: fig-dpu-difference-logos
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Difference logos for DPU, showing the amino-acid probability around
#|   upregulated sites minus that around downregulated sites in each contrast.
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 4.2
#| out-width: "60%"
difference_logo_plot(dpu_logo_sites)
```

## Results

```{r}
#| label: tbl-dpu-results
dt_table(
  dpu,
  "Differential PTM usage results",
  c(
    "protein_Id", "site", "gene_name.site", "modAA", "posInProtein",
    "SequenceWindow", "contrast", "diff.site", "diff.protein", "diff_diff",

  )
```

# CorrectFirst DPU

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Summary

CorrectFirst subtracts the protein abundance from the site abundance on the log2 scale and adds back the sample's median protein abundance before modelling. A protein value missing in a sample is taken from the protein DEA's `lm_impute` model, so every site whose protein was quantified is corrected. The fitted site effect is then the change in PTM usage.

::: {layout-ncol="2"}

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cf-estimate-counts
#| tbl-cap: "CorrectFirst site-contrast rows by estimate type. All are computed; this report shows only the observed ones."
estimate_count_table("CF")
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cf-modification-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Observed CorrectFirst rows by contrast and modified amino acid."
knitr::kable(modification_counts(cf_results))
```

:::

## Quality control

The two plots assess the protein-corrected sample-level values entering the CorrectFirst model.

::: {layout-ncol="2"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-cf-density
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Distribution of protein-corrected log2 PTM-site abundance by sample. Each
#|   curve is one sample; shifts or shape differences indicate global changes in
#|   the corrected values entering the CorrectFirst model.
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
safe_plot(
  cf_reported$ptm_data$get_Plotter()$intensity_distribution_density(),
  "CorrectFirst density plot unavailable."
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cf-pca
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   Principal-component analysis of protein-corrected PTM-site abundances.
#|   Points are samples, coloured by experimental group; the projection uses
#|   imputation only for visualization and does not refit the statistical model.
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
safe_plot(
  prolfqua::AggregateLimpa$new(
    cf_reported$ptm_data,
    impute_only = TRUE
  )$aggregate()$get_Plotter()$pca(),
  "CorrectFirst PCA unavailable."
)
```

:::

```{r}
#| label: fig-cf-volcano

#|   site modelled after sample-level protein correction; the x-axis is its log2
#|   fold change and the y-axis is -log10(FDR). Red points pass both displayed
#|   thresholds.
volcano_plot(cf_results, "diff.site", "FDR.site", "CorrectFirst differential PTM usage")
```

## Report provenance

```{r}
#| label: tbl-report-provenance
#| tbl-cap: "Report provenance and the final MuData input reference."
qmd_source <- fgczQuartoTemplate::fgcz_qmd_source_link()
provenance_table <- data.frame(
  Field = c(
    "Input MuData",
    "Source DEA artifacts",
    "Contrasts",
    "FDR threshold",
    "Absolute log2 fold-change threshold",
    "Report package",
    "Generated at",
    "Qmd source"
  ),
  Value = c(
    input_h5mu,
    paste(source_paths, collapse = "; "),
    paste(names(contrasts), collapse = "; "),
    format(fdr_threshold),
    format(fold_change_threshold),
    paste0("prophosqua ", utils::packageVersion("prophosqua")),
    generated_at,
    qmd_source
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
provenance_table <- provenance_table[nzchar(provenance_table$Value), , drop = FALSE]
knitr::kable(provenance_table, escape = FALSE)
```
